summary: Dragon Ball Z Kai is a straight cut-down of the manga: our 1-98 adapt chs 195-420 (Saiyan through Cell, roughly 2.3 chapters per episode, with Kanzenshuu giving page-level splits for every episode) and our 99-167 adapt chs 421-519 (Buu arc). Three sources agree on essentially every boundary outside one zone: Kanzenshuu's Kai episode guide ("Corresponding manga chapters" with page ranges), the Dragon Universe wiki DBK pages, and the Dragon Ball fandom Kai episode infoboxes (chapter-title lists resolved against the fandom chapter list). The complication is that our rows are the 69-episode INTERNATIONAL "Final Chapters" cut: eight episodes (101, 102, 103, 106, 108, 111, 113, 165) never aired in Japan, the Japanese eps 100-106 were re-edited into our 100-113 around the extra DBZ footage, and every per-episode source for the Buu arc uses the 61-episode Japanese numbering, so their pages for our 100/107/110/112 actually describe different (longer) episodes; that zone was mapped from Wikipedia's DBZ-footage column plus Kanzenshuu's DBZ chapter pages and marked medium. From our 114 (= JP 107) onward the two cuts coincide and the numbering offset is a constant 7 (166-167 = JP 158-159). Surprises: the context file's volume boundaries are wrong for v17+; ch 425 is never adapted; Kanzenshuu has two small omissions (297, 495); our row 128 carries ep 139's title and date.

structure.notes: Components confirmed: AniList 6033 = 97 eps (our 1-97, chs 195-418); AniList 11359 = the Japanese ep 98 that Fuji TV pulled after the 2011 Tohoku quake and released as a Blu-ray/DVD "extra" (our 98, chs 419-420); AniList 20635 = 69 episodes = the INTERNATIONAL "The Final Chapters" cut (our 99-167, chs 421-519). Our rows are the international cut: eight episodes never aired in Japan and carry 2017/2018 US dates (101, 102, 103, 106, 108, 111, 113, 165). Kanzenshuu and the Dragon Universe wiki number the Buu arc by the 61-episode Japanese broadcast (099-159); conversion used: our 99-100 = JP 99-100; our 104,105,107,109,110,112 = JP 101,102,103,104,105,106; our 114-164 = JP 107-157 (JP = ours - 7); our 166-167 = JP 158-159. The international cut re-edited JP eps 100-106 into our 100-113 with the extra DBZ footage; from our 114 (= JP 107) onward the two cuts are the same episodes (Wikipedia footage column matches Kanzenshuu). Volume boundaries in the context file are wrong for v17+ (it has v17 = 192-202); the tankobon boundaries per Wikipedia's List of Dragon Ball Z chapters and the fandom chapter list are v17 195-204, v18 205-216, v19 217-228, v20 229-240, v21 241-252, v22 253-264, v23 265-276, v24 277-288, v25 289-300, v26 301-313, v27 314-325, v28 326-337, v29 338-349, v30 350-361, v31 362-373, v32 374-385, v33 386-396, v34 397-408, v35 409-420, v36 421-432, v37 433-445, v38 446-459, v39 460-472, v40 473-485, v41 486-502, v42 503-519; all volumes in this file use these. Saga boundaries (our numbering): Raditz 1-3, Saiyan 4-16, Namek 17-31, Ginyu 32-35, Freeza 36-54, Trunks 55-58, Androids 59-67, Imperfect Cell 68-75, Perfect Cell 76-82, Cell Games 83-98, Great Saiyaman 99-105, World Tournament 106-114, Babidi 115-122, Majin Buu 123-140, Fusion 141-155, Kid Buu 156-165, Peaceful World 166-167. Chapter numbering used everywhere = the original 519-chapter Dragon Ball numbering (Viz "Dragon Ball Z" chapter N = original N+194; Viz DBZ volume N = JP volume N+16).

flags_for_sean: Volume boundaries in the context file (v17: 192-202 ... v26: 309-?) do not match the tankobon; Wikipedia (List of Dragon Ball Z chapters) and the fandom chapter list agree exactly on v17 195-204 through v42 503-519 (full table in structure.notes). All volumes here use the verified boundaries - the stored boundary table for volumes 17-42 should be replaced.

International re-cut zone (eps 100-113): the fandom and Kanzenshuu/DU pages for the JP-counterpart episodes 100, 107, 110, 112 describe the JAPANESE episode content, so their END chapters differ from what the international episode actually contains (JP 100 ends 426, JP 103 ends 435, JP 105 ends 441, JP 106 ends 445). END chapters for those four are taken from Wikipedia's "Corresponding DBZ ep." footage column + Kanzenshuu's DBZ chapter pages (100->424, 107->433, 110->439, 112->442), which is internally consistent with the fandom pages of the international-only episodes 102/103/106/108/111/113; marked medium. Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Dragon_Ball_Z_Kai_episodes , https://www.kanzenshuu.com/episode/dbz/eps-211/ , https://dragonball.fandom.com/wiki/A_Monster_is_Taken_Away!_The_Culprit_is_Great_Saiyaman%3F

Ch 425 ("Revealed!!!", Videl unmasks Gohan) is listed by Kanzenshuu as never adapted in DBZ or Kai (https://www.kanzenshuu.com/manga/db/chp-425/); the international ep 102 covers the beat via DBZ 204 filler footage. Continue point after ep 100 is therefore 425 (read it before ep 102 resumes at 426).

Ep 147: Kanzenshuu lists only ch 494 and its next entry starts at 496 (gap); DU and fandom list 494-495 - used 495 (the volleyball chapter matching the episode title), marked medium. https://www.kanzenshuu.com/episode/kai/eps-140/ vs https://dragonballuniverse.fandom.com/wiki/DBK140
Ep 38: Kanzenshuu omits ch 297 (its list is 298-300 p.1-5) while DU and fandom include 297; used start 297, END 300 (Kanzenshuu + DU).

Our row 128 has the wrong title and air date: it repeats ep 139's title ("Who Will Defeat Majin Buu? The Mightiest of Men Moves Out!") and date (2014-11-30). Ep 128 is "A Nightmare Revisited: The Immortal Monster Majin Buu!" (JP ep 121, aired 2014-09-14; chs 468-469 p.1-2). Data glitch only; anchors unaffected.

Open flag #692 (MU chapter count 149 vs AniList 520): the reading edition for these anchors is the original 519-chapter Japanese numbering (AniList 30042 counts 520 incl. a bonus). MU's 149 is not a chapter count of the same edition; the Viz "Dragon Ball Z" split renumbers chapter 195 as DBZ ch 1 (offset 194).

Start chapters follow the protocol majority rule (tail of the previous chapter -> first full chapter unless the tail is the bulk); chapters_adapted keeps the Kanzenshuu page splits, so the honest per-page truth is preserved even where start_chapter skips a short tail. Kanzenshuu page counts assume 14-page chapters where "End" is given.
